record.title: Hyperdrive Elevated Origin Connection Failure Rates

updates.body:
Some Hyperdrives experienced elevated failure rates when connecting to origin databases between 2026-09-16 22:45 UTC and 2026-09-17 00:45 UTC due to a misconfigured release. Hyperdrives connecting through Workers VPC or Cloudflare Access tunnels were not affected. 

This incident has been resolved.
